study type: Case-control study with in vitro experiments
cohort: The study included human placentas from first trimester, preterm, and term pregnancies, specifically comparing those affected by early-onset preeclampsia, late-onset preeclampsia, and FGR with control placentas, and also utilized human trophoblast stem cells (hTSCs) for in vitro experiments.
finding: LGR5 expression was significantly reduced, and LGR4 was elevated, in placentas from early-onset preeclampsia, late-onset preeclampsia, and FGR compared to controls, indicating dysregulation of LGR5/LGR4 and their signaling partners in preeclampsia and FGR.
cross-section timing: Placental samples were collected at first trimester, preterm, and term stages of pregnancy.
gest_age: First trimester, preterm, term, and categories implied by early-onset and late-onset preeclampsia.
